summary: Ares Strategic Income Fund filed an 8-K announcing the amendment and restatement of its senior secured credit facility with JPMorgan Chase. The agreement extends the revolving period to May 21, 2030 and maturity to May 21, 2031, increases aggregate commitments from $3.25B to $4.1B (with an accordion feature up to ~$6.15B), and revises interest rate mechanics to Term SOFR plus spreads of 1.525%-1.775% or alternate base rate plus 0.525%-0.775%. Commitment fees are 0.325% on undrawn amounts. This is a routine debt-refinancing event, not a special situation.
